'''Oppio Sliveri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he became one of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] top 10 most wanted fugitives when he stole the entire content of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Romal]]'s summer villa, including an urn containing the ashes of his deceased mother. An unknown [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] tracked him down and killed him.
